visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Centre with translate
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The box is centred inside its parent by two negative margins. Use position absolute with top and left of 50% and transform translate(-50%, -50%). It must stay centred.

solution.explanation: translate(-50%, -50%) moves the element back by half of its own size, so no number depends on the size. With margins, changing the size of the pin means changing the margins too.

checks.label: The pin is centred sideways
checks.expr: (() => { var s = el('.stage').getBoundingClientRect(), d = el('.pin').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs((s.left + s.width / 2) - (d.left + d.width / 2)) < 1; })()

checks.label: The pin is centred up and down
checks.expr: (() => { var s = el('.stage').getBoundingClientRect(), d = el('.pin').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs((s.top + s.height / 2) - (d.top + d.height / 2)) < 1; })()
